title: Coordination number, ligand denticity and the first chelate closure
description:
The second distinct donor site is the first chelate closure; each later site preserves the complete prior topology and adds exactly one to denticity.

Maria Smith derives coordination number from distinct central-incidence cardinality, retained entity identity, ligand-specific donor counting and arbitrary finite successor closure. Includes complete classification of three original 256-candidate grammars, all 67 registered external source records, explicit mathematical arguments and 440 distinct empty-axiom audited Lean declarations. Original binding-site, kappa and eta distinctions are retained with complete pinned V3 and V4 evidence and portable reproduction.
